text:
Ana Romero: Heads-up — marketplace cutover tomorrow. Final preflight for press/blog/landing/SI handoffs. Need owners for traffic routing, embargo lift timing, and SI oncall. I'll paste the lightweight checklist below — please ack and call out blockers.

Ana Romero: ```
- embargo lift: 09:00 PT
- press release + blog publish: 09:00 PT
- redirect /marketplace -> partner storefront: 09:02 PT
- landing CTA toggle (A/B): flip at 09:05 PT via feature flag marketplace_cta_v2
- SI oncall standby: 08:50-12:00 PT
- cache warm + canary rollout: 08:45-09:15 PT (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
```

Matt Chen: I can own traffic routing and the redirect. @Alexa Park can you confirm DNS TTLs and the redirect config is tested?

Alexa Park: DNS TTLs: staging=60s, prod=300s. I'll temporarily lower prod to 60s at 07:30 PT. Redirect tested with curl (looks good). Example check: `curl -I https://redwood.ai/marketplace` -> 302 -> partner storefront.

Parul Singh: Marketing will publish blog + tweet thread at 09:00 PT. Press assets are in the shared folder and embargoed. @Kevin O'Leary we need legal sign-off on partner quote in the blog.

Kevin O'Leary: Signed off on the quote, added tiny legal microcopy: "partner-approved" line. One ask: do not push partner logos to public social until 09:10 PT per partner request.

Jess Carter: Landing page changes merged. CTA toggle is behind feature flag `marketplace_cta_v2`. I'll leave it staged and handoff to release-bot to flip at go-time. Rollback is trivial.

SI_oncall_bot: SI oncall roster: Sam Gupta (primary), Priya Rao (backup). Pager duty window 08:50-12:00 PT. Runbook: https://redwood.corp/runbooks/marketplace.

Matt Chen: Infra plan: warm caches at 08:45 PT, canary 08:50 (5% traffic), then 25% @08:55, 100% @09:05. We'll monitor error-rate and latency; rollback id is `canary-rollback-2024-9`.

Alexa Park: Heads-up — quantized endpoints for partner workloads reported slightly higher cold latency yesterday. Eng-infra is verifying capacity now. If tail latency >150ms we'll route to hosted variant as fallback.

Parul Singh: Press ops will do a dry-run at 08:30 PT with embargoed assets. Also updating the SKU mapping doc for cloud marketplace — Matt can you call out missing GPU tier SKUs?

Matt Chen: Noted — one blocker: marketplace listing missing SKU mapping for some GPU tiers (p4/p10). @Parul can you push the SKU mapping to partner ops doc before EOD?

Parul Singh: On it, will update and ping partner PMs once done. Also want confirmation: all press quotes are timestamped in UTC? We prefer that.

Kevin O'Leary: Confirmed — use UTC timestamps in press copy. Also small legal reminder: embargo applies only to named outlets in the press list; internal org posts OK, external partners must wait the extra 10 minutes as requested.

Jess Carter: Rollback command for the CTA flip (if needed):
```
release-bot rollback marketplace_cta_v2
```
I'll keep a dev on standby to re-deploy fixes if anything regress.

release-bot: Flag flip scheduled: marketplace_cta_v2 -> ON at 09:05 PT. I will create an audit log entry and attach rollback token rback-923.

Ana Romero: Owners summary: Traffic=Matt, DNS/redirect=Alexa, Marketing=Parul, Legal=Kevin, Landing/Flag=Jess, SI oncall=Sam/Priya, Release automation=release-bot. Everyone pls confirm and add any last-minute preflight items.

Parul Singh: :thumbsup: Confirmed. Press ops will stand by for embargo lift.

Kevin O'Leary: Noted about partner logo delay — adding to the checklist.

Matt Chen: I'll run the warm/canary plan and post live metrics in #launch-runner. If anything looks off I'll trigger canary-rollback.

Ana Romero: Final — meet in #launch-runner at 08:20 PT for the final green-light. I'll post go/no-go at 08:40 PT. :rocket:
